sections.heading: What is trending: “drinkwater”
paragraphs: “drinkwater” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for NL (snapshot taken 2026-08-23T08:48:34+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 100 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from AD.nl, De Telegraaf, bouwenuitvoering. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “8 miljard liter drinkwater uit de polder? ‘Dit wordt een grote surfplas’” — AD.nl
“Watermeters worden op grote schaal vervangen door Vitens” — bouwenuitvoering
“D66-wethouder staat achter komst nieuw datacenter in Amsterdam, ondanks ’tyfusveel’ waterverbruik” — De Telegraaf

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Sun, 23 Aug 2026 01:00:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-23T08:48:34+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-23T08:49:32+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.a: Google's Trending Now feed links the spike to coverage from AD.nl, De Telegraaf, bouwenuitvoering.
